snippet.title: BLIGHTEN - Official Next Fest Trailer
snippet.description:
Watch the Demo Launch Trailer for Blighten, the retro survival first-person horror shooter developed by Blight Software. Players will explore a facility overrun by creatures infected by the Blight. Take up arms, scavenge for resources, and survive what lurks in the shadows. Blighten is coming soon to PC (Steam), with a Playtest available now for PC (Steam).

Play the Demo here: https://store.steampowered.com/app/44...

Join the Discord: https://discord.com/invite/QkuwKXYSnG


#gaming #gametrailers #doom #residentevil #horrorgaming
